title: [Main]Subcontracting Order Date does not account for lead time before the routing operation starts
summary: Subcontracting order dates now correctly calculate backward from the routing operation start date using the purchase lead time, and prices are refreshed when the order date changes on existing orders.
key_points: Order Date calculation now accounts for purchase lead time from routing start date
SetSubcontractingOrderDate method added to handle consistent date logic across Calculate Subcontracts and direct routing creation flows
Carry Out Action no longer overwrites worksheet dates with purchase header order date for subcontracting lines
Price refresh logic improved to treat pre-price fallback costs as automatic so correct prices apply to the calculated order date
Expected and Requested Receipt Dates also set correctly on new and rescheduled purchase lines
quote: Subcontracting Order Date does not account for lead time before the routing operation starts
